scene: A checkered picnic mat holds a buzzing bento box and curiosities.
picture: First-person top-down close view of the blue checkered picnic mat. On the left lies a glossy neon postcard showing a skyscraper carnival. In the centre sits a vibrating yellow metal bento box with a flashing digital timer. On the right rests an unopened purple juice carton with a bendy straw.
